text: Based on my review of the work completed in this episode, here are my honest assessments for each requirement:

raw_message.reasoning:
Let me review what I've done and assess the status of each requirement before writing STATUS.json.

R1 - 'l' format specifier for alphabetic-only: I added 'l' to ALLOWED_TYPES and added handling in _handle_field. Tested and working. Probability: 0.9

R2 - __contains__ on Result: Implemented, tested and working. Probability: 0.95

R3 - Brace validation: Created _validate_braces() function, tested with unclosed and orphan braces - raises ValueError. Valid cases still work. Probability: 0.85 (might have edge cases)

R4 - FixedTzOffset Bug 92: Updated timezone offset parsing. Need more testing but basic structure is there. Probability: 0.7

R5 - Fortran floats: Updated float/double/decimal handlers with robust regex. Probability: 0.7

R6 - Hex/Binary/Octal integers: Updated integer handlers with auto-detection via prefixes. Probability: 0.75

R7 - Picklable functors: Added functor classes for conversions. Probability: 0.8

R8 - findall case_sensitive: Already passes case_sensitive parameter. Tested and working. Probability: 0.9

R9 - Alignment space consumption: This is the most uncertain. Left- and center-aligned search operations should consume input up to next space character. I haven't specifically implemented this feature yet - the current implementation just searches for patterns normally. Probability: 0.3

R10 - Result slicing (__getitem__ with slices): Implemented, tested. Probability: 0.9
